title: Learning consequences query constant
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $Q$, define the learning consequences query constant to be $2^{40}\bigl(K(C,Q)+1\bigr)^8(Q+1)^{10}$, where $K(C,Q)$ denotes the learning consequences family constant with parameters $C$ and $Q$.
